# T3Zepp

> T3 Code companion for Amazfit.
> Bring the useful bits of T3 Code to your Amazfit watch: quick updates on usage, limits, notifications, and more.

## Product

- T3Zepp runs on Zepp OS. Compatibility is confirmed for Amazfit T-Rex 3 running Zepp OS 4.0.
- The public Zepp Store app uses the hosted proxy at https://t3zepp.devarshi.dev.
- Most users do not need to build the app or host a proxy.
- To connect, users provide a publicly reachable HTTPS URL for their T3 Code server and a read-only session token, then pair their watch using the setup dashboard.
- The T3 Code session token is stored by the gateway and is not sent to the watch. The watch uses a separate revocable device key.
- The app is free and licensed under AGPL-3.0.
- T3Zepp is not affiliated with T3 Tools.

## Key pages

- [Overview](https://t3zepp.devarshi.dev/): product details and common questions.
- [Installation and setup](https://t3zepp.devarshi.dev/install/): install the public app, connect a T3 Code server, and pair a watch.
- [Pairing dashboard](https://t3zepp.devarshi.dev/pair/): create a pairing code and manage a device key. This page is for interactive use and is not indexed.
- [Privacy policy](https://t3zepp.devarshi.dev/privacy/): data stored and processed by the app and hosted gateway.
- [Terms of use](https://t3zepp.devarshi.dev/terms/): service terms.
- [Source code](https://github.com/devarshishimpi/t3zepp): app, gateway, and site source.

## Optional self-hosting

Self-hosting the proxy or building the watch app from source is optional. Instructions are in the repository README.
